    return y[i]

def finite_diff_jacobian(f, x, eps=1e-7):
    x = jnp.asarray(x, dtype=jnp.float64)
    f_x = f(x)
    n = x.shape[0]
    m = f_x.shape[0]
    J = np.zeros((m, n))
    for j in range(n):
        e_j = iota(j, n)
        J[:, j] = (f(x + eps * e_j) - f(x - eps * e_j)) / (2 * eps)
    return J
